title: Vanishing influence modulus
statement: Let $\varepsilon$ assign to each $\delta\in[0,1/2]$ a number in $[0,1]$. Suppose $\varepsilon(\delta)$ tends to $0$ as positive $\delta$ tends to $0$ within $[0,1/2]$. For each natural number $n$, define the influence modulus to be $1$ if $n<2$, and otherwise to be $\min\{1,\frac{2}{1-e^{-2}}\varepsilon(1/n)\}$. This modulus tends to $0$ as $n$ tends to infinity.
